inputs.name: runAudit.path
inputs.description: Project directory to audit, resolved with node:path resolve() against the current working directory and used as the audit root, as the loop-state root when a loop is set, and as the root given to the clean-code analytics record. runAudit does not check that the directory exists.

inputs.name: runAudit.options
inputs.description: Audit command flags: profile defaults to 'auto' and must be app, auto, dapp or lib; cleanCode, gate, dryRun and refresh are forwarded to auditProject as cleanCode.enabled, cleanCode.gate, cleanCode.dryRun and cleanCode.refresh; json (which takes precedence over coverage) prints the whole result, and coverage selects the coverage view. Unset loop, step, task and report fall back to their HARNESS_ANALYTICS_* variables and agentModel to HARNESS_AGENT_MODEL, and resolvedContext and validateReport check them before the audit runs.

outputs.name: runAudit
outputs.description: Resolves to undefined after console.log has printed the audit: the whole result as JSON when json is set, otherwise the findings text (or the coverage view when coverage is set) followed by the clean-code summary when one was produced. The exit status is not part of the resolved value; it is set on process.exitCode to cleanCodeExitCode(result), which returns 0, 1 or 2.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by resolvedContext when task is set together with loop or step, after the HARNESS_ANALYTICS_* defaults are applied; the message is 'Use either --task or --loop/--step.'

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by resolvedContext when step is set without loop; the message is '--step requires --loop.'

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by resolvedContext when a loop is set and the loop state has no step whose id equals step; the message is 'Loop step does not exist.'

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by validateReport when report is set and does not match /^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$/; the message is 'Invalid report ID.'

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejected by validateReport when runs/<report>/manifest.json under PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME (default $HOME/.codex/project-reports) cannot be read; a missing manifest rejects with a Node ENOENT error.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by parseAuditProfile through fail when options.profile (or 'auto' when omitted) is not app, auto, dapp or lib; the message names the unsupported value and lists auto, app, dapp and lib.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Propagated, not created here: runAudit has no try/catch, so an error thrown or rejected by auditProject, recordCleanCode or readLoop (called by resolvedContext when a loop is set) reaches the caller unchanged.
